conditions: Valid while PT-1005 / PIC-1005 are in service and PV-1005 is not isolated. Confirm alarm is not shelved or suppressed before relying on it.
rationale: SIF-100-01 trips at 68 barg on PT-1001A/B/C (SIS, L-101). PT-1005 is a BPCS pressure transmitter on L-102 immediately downstream of V-1002, the protected vessel, two process hops from the SIS sensors: same pressure system, separate transmitter, separate system. Its PAH at 60 barg (Medium) annunciates 8 barg below the trip point, giving operations time to act. Independent of any single bypassed SIS element. Recommend raising PAH-1005 priority to High for the duration of a bypass.

conditions: Only while PT-1001A itself is in service. NOT a compensating measure when PT-1001A is the bypassed element or when the bypass is applied at the input of the logic solver for channel A.
rationale: PAH-1001 at 62 barg (High) is derived from PT-1001A, one of the SIF's own 2oo3 initiators (register X11). It is a useful pre-alarm when the bypass is on PT-1001B, PT-1001C, XV-1001 or BDV-1001, because the sensor keeps working; it shares a failure mode with the SIF and is therefore ranked second, behind the independent BPCS measurement.

conditions: Valid while LT-1006 / LIC-1006 are in service and LV-1006 is available. Confirm alarm is not shelved.
rationale: SIF-100-02 trips at 1750 mm (87.5 % of the 0-2000 mm span) on LT-1002A/B (SIS, GWR, on V-1002). LT-1006 is the BPCS DP level transmitter on the same vessel, on the LIC-1006 control loop, independent of the SIS transmitters. Its LAH at 75 % (High) annunciates 12.5 % of span before the trip. LIC-1006 also acts on LV-1006 to bring level down, so the operator has both an alarm and a control response. LG-1002 (magnetic gauge, local) is a field cross-check only, not a compensating measure in its own right.

SIF-100-03 trips XV-1001 at 5 barg low-low on PT-1001D (1oo1). There is NO low-pressure alarm in the alarm register: PT-1005 (BPCS) has only a PAH, PT-1001A/B/C have only PAH-1001, and PI-1001 is a local gauge. No compensating alarm can be curated. Recommendation: configure a PAL on PT-1005 (or on PT-1001A) above 5 barg before any bypass of SIF-100-03 is authorised; until then the only compensating measure is a manual field round on PI-1001 at a defined interval, which must be stated explicitly in the bypass authorisation. Data caveat: PT-1001D is not in the instrument index (register X4); its location and range are unknown.
